description: Voice Notes in DMs - Fix the VoiceRecorder component to upload audio via Cloudinary instead of the broken Supabase storage path, and ensure proper integration in the Conversation page.
steps: Modify `src/components/dm/VoiceMessage.tsx` VoiceRecorder component: (a) Remove the `import { supabase }` line at the top. (b) Import `uploadToCloudinary` from `@/lib/cloudinary`. (c) In the `send` function, replace the Supabase storage upload with: `const publicUrl = await uploadToCloudinary(blobRef.current);`. This will upload the audio blob to Cloudinary and return the secure URL. (d) Remove the hardcoded 'https://example.com/audio.webm' placeholder.

Verify `src/pages/Conversation.tsx` integration is correct: The `sendVoice` function already handles the flow (receives mediaUrl from VoiceRecorder's onSend callback, creates a message doc in Firestore with media_url and media_type 'audio', updates conversation metadata). Confirm that the VoiceRecorder is shown when text input is empty (already done - conditional render at bottom of composer). No changes should be needed in Conversation.tsx.

Add a simple unit test in `src/components/dm/VoiceMessage.test.tsx` that tests the VoiceBubble component renders with proper play/pause button and time display. Mock the Audio element. Test that clicking play toggles the button state.
acceptance_criteria: VoiceRecorder in VoiceMessage.tsx uses uploadToCloudinary instead of Supabase storage or placeholder URL
No supabase import remains in VoiceMessage.tsx
Conversation.tsx sendVoice function correctly integrates with VoiceRecorder (already working, just confirm no breakage)
